name: jev-agent-skills
goal: Prove installed agent skills accurately explain Jev review outcomes and session operations, are discoverable across local projects, and keep credentials private.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Scoped two agent skills for manual Jev Clean Code review and automatic session operations. Proof requires valid skills, matching documented behavior, global installation, cross-project discovery and offline commands; no extra live provider probe.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Created two focused skills with UI metadata; installed byte-identical global copies and linked them from the repository Harness skill, AGENTS.md, README and global harness-project. Covered the Clean Code-inspired rubric, uncertainty, advisory/gate differences, credentials, cache, startup snapshots and exact-definition hook trust.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Both source and installed skills passed quick_validate using the bundled Python runtime; updated global harness-project also passed. Six cross-skill links resolve. Read-only Codex skills/list reported both skills enabled with user scope and no skill errors for Harness and Fluora. Four offline CLI exercises passed: advisory preview, gate preview, installed session dry run and unrelated-project skip.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: bun run check exited 0: formatting, type checks, lint, 180 CLI unit tests, 56 CLI E2Es, 1 packaged-report test, 84 report unit tests, builds and both audits passed. Twenty-five opt-in live tests were skipped. The live startup hook separately reported incomplete; this was not treated as a clean judgment or used as live quality proof.
